The '''krendel''' was a large, [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]-like creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Recopia]], with glossy [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin and vibrant blue and green mottled spots running down its back. It had large, bulbous black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and rubbery, sticky pads on its feet that allowed it to climb sheer rock surfaces. Krendels were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] and raised in Recopia's toxic [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfuric]] seas but soon developed [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] and [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], enabling them to venture onto land in search of [[Diet/Legends|prey]]. They primarily hunted [[Seabird/Legends|seabirds]] nesting in the island cliffs. As krendels had poor eyesight, they relied primarily on their sense of smell and motion detection to locate prey. They hunted in mated pairs and generally avoided [[City/Legends|settled areas]], although they occasionally blundered over cliffs and into communities.<ref name="CW" />

Krendels possessed two means of attack. Their gaping [[Mouth/Legends|maws]], filled with sharp, needle-like [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], were dangerous enough, but they could also spew corrosive [[Gas/Legends|gas]] from a distended throat sac. The gas streamed out in a cone extending up to 10 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Krendel was designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CW" />
